name: scope-commits-without-error
description: The transactional scope with the TestComponent step not throwing (module config orders.throw-after-insert=false): the row is committed and the JMS outbound sends the db:insert result (update count 1, an Integer, so an ObjectMessage) to 'out' in the same transaction. One delivery, nothing redelivered or dead-lettered.

source.reference: using-transactional-scope-in-jms-to-database/src/main/app/transactions.xml (db:insert parameterized-query -> jms:outbound-endpoint queue="out" JOIN_IF_POSSIBLE inside ee:multi-transactional); Mule 3.8 db:insert returns the update count as payload; Mule JMS ObjectToJMSMessage sends Serializable payloads as ObjectMessage
